My dear [Marianne](../persons.html#1546)
The great heads will be 1/6, but I fear they will be long in coming like all the rest.[^1]
I will thankfully send you some of all kinds when I get them.

In haste your aff

C M Yonge

[^1]: Copies of the photographs mentioned in the letter of July 20 to Marianne Bigg Wither were probably being made by a photographer in Plymouth.
